reviews_5s:
Cute jars! Sized as a large baby food jar, so, for me, I see multiple uses. Comes with small labels and a chalk pen. Packaged really well with thick foam that holds each jar in place very snuggly (this makes them perfect for storage). Lids seem a bit flimsy but I used them anyway. Canned my orange marmalade and mango chutney with them.
I will check often in case the lids fail. Will order again.These jars are perfect for canning especially making jams or jelly and the price is reasonable for 24 jars plus you get the rings and lids.Before purchasing these jars, I asked if they were suitable for canning. A couple of people told me they were not while admitting that they had not used them for that purpose. This is something that drives me crazy. The manufacturer reached out to me with technical information regarding temperatures the jars could withstand. This was exactly what I was looking for. I trusted the manufacturer and used these jars to can chicken broth. I pressure canned it at 10 pounds pressure for 75 minutes. I had no issues at all with the jars breaking or lids leaking. All jars sealed perfectly. The glass is nice and thick. I was impressed and with Ball and Kerr no longer making jars, I know now that this company is reliable for replacement jars as needed.Filled 1 hour after reserving jars 10 jars strawberries freezer jam worked great good price too yah amazonI like to cook with lots of different herbs but the little store I shop at has bigger jars and once opened can go weak. I put the spices and herbs in there, use a suction jar sealer to preserve freshness. Open and get what amount you need then reseal.Jars are perfect for what I needed them for. (Homemade freezer jam). They sealed up very nicely.PerfectJust what I wanted. Durable the lids fit tight and I love the pattern on the glass

My husband likes to use as drinking glassesvery well packed, no breakage or chips. great deal, great deliveryI used them to make cheesecake in a jar as a gift for my coworkers,
Everyone was blown away, the jars where beautiful!
The shape made for a perfect gift, they were easy to wash and fill due to their wide opening and the tags helped with labeling the flavors and recipients.

10 out of 10 will be buying this again when I get paid!
reviews_1s:
1 just processed 9 jars of jam in these jars. I tried to use my regular mouth lids and rings because I don't
care for the lids that came with the jars. l screwed the lids on finger tip tight and placed them in the water
bath. While I was cleaning up my mess, I heard popping. I looked in the canner and all but one of my lids
had popped off ruining my jam because the jars filled with water. I looked on the description and saw
nothing written saying you had to use their lids, and I looked in their store for replacement lids. None
there. So these jars are a one time use product unless you can find replacement lids. I've been canning for more than 40 years and this is a first for me.I am so disappointed in these lids. They are one piece! It's impossible to see if the jars have sealed properly. The description states these are canning jars, so I hope they actually work. Of course the lids cannot be reused and normal Ball canning lids/bands do not fit these jars. Environmentally unfriendly! Not the typical canning style with a flat lid and screw band. Screw bands can be reused. Now I am going to have to figure out which jars use which lids. What a hassle! Doesn't appear that you can purchase additional lids to reuse the jars. I will NOT purchase these again.I have been canning for 40 years and have never had a Ball jar break in the canner. I only got these because I wanted the 12 oz. jar, which I can no longer find in the US, and also because they reviewed so well. Not worth it to lose a jar of apple butter which is time- consuming to make. I also bought Chinese made lids and had one blow right off a jar of peach jam (in the canner); also a first. I will not bother with a brand I don't know I can trust, especially with all the time put into canning.Great price but after initial wash before putting our food inside, there was rust on the lids. Not a safe applicable use for an item intended for meal prepping or long term use for food.The jars seem fine. I use my own lids, but the rings are terrible. Have caused me to mess up on a couple things as I popped off or they were bent.These jars do not have regular size lids. Only the lids that come with them will fit on them and they are one piece not two piece and that is why I am returning them.2 out of 20 shattered wnder vaccuume presure making a big mess in my chamber sealer, i will test all mason jars empty first from now onThis item arrived with two of the jars broken inside of the carton. Additionally, the lid provided only sealed on six of the remaining 10 jars. By reheating the jam and resterilizing the jars, lids, and rings, I was able to get them to seal with Ball lids. .Hence, the waste of time, resources, and a repeat clean-up afterwards, I didn’t save me any money with these jars. The only result I found was aggravation. Don’t subject yourself to this, purchase brand name jars, e.g. Ball or Mason.every jar is broken and can’t use them.Bought the as new box received what appear to be a return label on a previous returned jars one jars bottom broken. The others warped.
